chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Mirdas, from Safwan ibn Yahya and al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Ammar al-Sabati, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام): Which is superior: worship in secret with the concealed Imam from among you during the rule of falsehood, or worship in the manifestation of the truth and its rule with the manifest Imam from among you?

He said: O Ammar, charity in secret, by Allah, is better than charity in public; and likewise, by Allah, your worship in secret with your concealed Imam during the rule of falsehood, and your fear of your enemy in the rule of falsehood and in a state of truce, is better than one who worships Allah, Mighty and Majestic is His remembrance, in the manifestation of the truth with the manifest Imam of truth in the rule of truth. Worship with fear in the rule of falsehood is not like worship with safety in the rule of truth.

And know that whoever among you today performs an obligatory salat in congregation at its appointed time while concealing it from his enemy, then completes it, Allah will record for him fifty obligatory congregational prayers. And whoever among you performs an obligatory salat alone at its appointed time while concealing it from his enemy, then completes it, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will record for him twenty-five obligatory prayers performed individually.

And whoever among you performs a supererogatory salat at its proper time and completes it, Allah will record for him ten supererogatory prayers. And whoever among you performs a good deed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will record for him twenty good deeds. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, multiplies the good deeds of the believer among you many times over when he perfects his deeds, practices taqiyyah for the sake of his religion, his Imam, and himself, and restrains his tongue. Surely Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is Generous.

I said: May I be made your ransom, by Allah, you have indeed made me desirous of action and urged me toward it, but I would like to know how it is that today our deeds have become better than the deeds of the companions of the manifest Imam from among you in the rule of truth, while we are upon one religion.

He said: You preceded them in entering into the religion of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and in salat, sawm, hajj, every good deed and fiqh, and in worshipping Allah, Mighty is His remembrance, secretly from your enemy with your concealed Imam, while obeying him, remaining patient with him, awaiting the rule of truth, and fearing for your Imam and yourselves from the oppressive kings.

You are waiting for the right of your Imam and your rights while they are in the hands of the oppressors. They have prevented you from that and compelled you to labor in the world and seek livelihood, while remaining patient in your religion, your worship, your obedience to your Imam, and your fear before your enemy. Because of that, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has multiplied the deeds for you; so glad tidings to you.

I said: May I be made your ransom, then what is your view if we should become among the companions of al-Qa'im and the truth should appear? Are we today, in your Imamate and obedience, better in deeds than the companions of the rule of truth and justice?

He said: Glory be to Allah! Do you not love that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, should manifest truth and justice in the lands, gather the word together, reconcile between differing hearts, so that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is not disobeyed in His earth, His prescribed limits are established among His creation, and Allah returns the truth to its people, so that it becomes manifest until nothing of the truth is concealed out of fear of anyone among creation?
Indeed, by Allah, O Ammar, no one among you dies upon the state that you are upon except that he is better in the sight of Allah than many of the martyrs of Badr and Uhud. So receive glad tidings.

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: religious dissimulation for protection of religion, the Imam, and oneself under danger
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the divinely appointed Imam whose authority is to be obeyed
key_terms.الْعِبَادَةُ: worship and devotional obedience to Allah
key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: the one who shall arise, the awaited Imam al-Mahdi
key_terms.الْمُلُوكِ الظَّلَمَةِ: the oppressive kings who wrongfully hold power
key_terms.الْهُدْنَةِ: a state of truce or suspended confrontation
key_terms.دَوْلَةِ الْبَاطِلِ: the rule or regime of falsehood and illegitimate power
key_terms.دَوْلَةِ الْحَقِّ: the rule or order of truth and rightful authority

ai.seo_question: Why does worship during the time of concealment and oppression carry greater reward in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that worship, obedience, and patience under concealment and oppression with loyalty to the Imam can carry greater reward than worship performed openly under a just and manifest rule. It emphasizes taqiyyah, steadfastness, restraint, and awaiting the victory of truth, while also affirming the believers’ longing for the appearance of justice and the restoration of rightful authority.
